trigger.note: ST43 (paid base reel spin) triggers the FreeSpin feature via ReMarks='TriggerFreespin' (376/40000 in-sample). ST44 is the granted free reel spin (cost=0, ReMarks='FreeSpin' x3113; re-trigger 'FreeSpinTriggerFreespin' x15). Both STs settle via their NATIVE PayoutIdToWinAmount payids — no synthesized pid needed (every win round carries a populated native payid: 14549/14549 ST43, 1632/1632 ST44). No live collect channel (no SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols). EXACT M87 archetype precedent.

validation.evidence: W1 (onboard-implementer, fleet batch 2026-06-18; 40000 ST43 + 3128 ST44 rounds, 1 real _cache_version:3 chunk, single config bucket e70fb892/39c0f03f, _bet=1000). ST inventory = 2 SpinTypes, both STANDARD full-reel signature (StopSymbolsByCol+PayoutByPayline+PayoutIdToWinAmount+RewardLastNode+ReelSkin+ReMarks+WinCredits) — field set BYTE-IDENTICAL to the confirmed M87 archetype (ST43 paid_spin/Normal + ST44 freespin/FreeSpin). ST43 role=paid_spin (CostCredits=1000, GameplayTriggerType=0, ReMarks empty x39624 except 'TriggerFreespin' x376 -> opens freespin). ST44 role=freespin (CostCredits=0 granted, ReMarks='FreeSpin' x3113 / 'FreeSpinTriggerFreespin' x15 re-trigger). NO live-collect channel (SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols ALL absent at 0/43128 rounds); RewardLastNode is a payline-node list mirroring the payid keys (e.g. ['8-'] for pid {8}), NOT a ticking collect counter. EVERY win round carries a populated native PayoutIdToWinAmount -> ZERO win-without-payid -> no additive collect residual -> no synth rule. CurJackpotStoreWin present on 100% of rounds but =0 on 100% (test-interface-zeroed, fleet-wide behavior). Both STs supportable manifest-only via the generic PER_SPINTYPE plugins (paid_spin) + the existing freespin_dynamics plugin (freespin role, already validated/wired — M275/M43/M278). No NEW plugin, no synth rule, round_win_rule null. rtp_integrity.paid_st=[43] (ST44 cost=0 excluded from RTP denominator). Awaiting onboard-tester + breaker + user domain sign-off (gate 8).
caveats: ST44 freespin per-round retrigger-depth / free-spin-count histogram needs per-round sequence accumulation in parser.py (base-closure) — freespin_dynamics surfaces the base-excluded aggregate; the depth histogram is parser_blind. Framework-team item (same per-ST-extraction boundary as M43 minigame node-list).

Per-skin (ReelSkin) labeled breakout is parser_blind: the plugin layer receives coarse per-ST RETURN_BUCKET histograms, not per-round ReelSkin (same boundary as M279 skin-11). The skin's CONTRIBUTION is captured (pooled into the per-ST multiplier distribution). Framework-team item IF a labeled per-skin metric is wanted.

out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST43/ST44 round but =0 on 100% of in-sample records (0/43128 nonzero). FLEET-WIDE test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12, M275 gate 8): a real progressive jackpot store whose accumulation efficiency the CURRENT testspin interface forces to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST43/ST44 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the test interface is optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The data RTP is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive); the progressive ADDS on top once the interface enables it.
